en-US.author: Matt Kirkland
en-US.description: Recognizes bird vocalizations in audio recordings.
en-US.longDescription: Chirpity is your ultimate companion for identifying bird vocalisations. Designed with Nocmig enthusiasts and bioacoustic researchers in mind, Chirpity revolutionises the process of reviewing extensive audio files for the presence of avian sounds. Powered by cutting-edge Machine Learning, Chirpity offers the choice between the well-known BirdNET and a bespoke Nocmig model - finely tuned for Nocturnal Flight Calls - ensuring identification tailored to your specific needs. With intuitive features for reviewing, tagging, and organizing detected calls, Chirpity saves valuable time and effort.
en-US.name: Chirpity
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's New
- Added a localized button to clear all notifications at once; cleared or dismissed notifications are removed.
Bug Fixes
- Result selection now waits for the requested audio file and region to load, reducing mismatches between selected results and active audio.
- Context-menu selection now checks that the result’s file and region match the active audio.
- WAV metadata scanning now handles padded chunks and waits for metadata reads to finish, improving extraction reliability.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Mattk70/Chirpity-Electron/compare/v6.3.0...v6.3.1

zh-CN.description: 识别音频录音中的鸟类鸣声。
zh-CN.longDescription: Chirpity 是您识别鸟类鸣声的终极伙伴。Chirpity 专为夜间迁徙（Nocmig）爱好者和生物声学研究人员设计，彻底改变了从海量音频文件中审查鸟鸣声的过程。凭借尖端的机器学习技术，Chirpity 提供了两种选择：知名的 BirdNET 模型，以及专为夜间飞行鸣叫（NFC）优化的定制化 Nocmig 模型——确保识别结果精准符合您的特定需求。通过直观的审查、标记和管理功能，Chirpity 为您节省了宝贵的时间与精力。
